subject: Roadmap check: ISO27001 scope decisions + FedRAMP pre-audit runbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@acmeenterprise.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@govcloud.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Roadmap check: ISO27001 scope decisions + FedRAMP pre-audit runbook

Claire / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time earlier this week. As we prepare for the upcoming vendor review at Acme, I wanted to confirm a few scope items that will materially affect our ISO27001 & FedRAMP timelines, and propose a short pre-audit runbook we can walk through together. TL;DR — see action items at the bottom.

Key scope questions:
- Primary environment: will the assessment focus on our hosted Redwood API (multi-tenant hosted) or the Dedicated/Private deployment footprint? We need clarity because control coverage (network, tenancy, pen-test frequency) differs.
- Data residency: confirm whether Acme requires EU-only controls or if US + EU is acceptable. That will affect evidence sets and FedRAMP boundary mapping.
- Integrations: please list any third-party connectors (particularly cloud storage or SIEM ingest) that should be included in the evidence package.

Proposed pre-audit runbook (draft):
1) Kickoff call (30m) — align scope and evidence list.
2) Evidence lock window (7 days) — owners freeze config changes, collect artifacts.
3) Technical deep-dive (network, IAM, key management) — 60m with infra team.
4) Mock interview w/ assessor — 45m to surface gaps.

Attachment: pre-audit-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with proposed owners & artifact list)

Action items for this thread:
- Claire: confirm scope (hosted vs dedicated) and any regulatory notes from your procurement team.
- Tom: if FedRAMP requires an authority-to-operate pre-check, let us know the benchmark audits you expect.
- Laura & Karthik: can you validate the current artifact readiness and point owners?

I can run the kickoff as soon as we have scope confirmed.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, GTM Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Roadmap check: ISO27001 scope decisions + FedRAMP pre-audit runbook

Thanks, Jonas —
Appreciate the clear runbook. A couple quick clarifications from procurement/infosec before we lock the kickoff: 
1) Scope: Acme wants the hosted Redwood API to be in-scope for ISO27001. We may also request a limited review of Dedicated for one pilot integration, but the primary focus is hosted for now.
2) Residency: US only for the initial engagement; EU will be a follow-up (timeboxed).
3) Integrations: our security team flagged two connectors — s3-backup@acme and splunk-ingest@acme — they want to confirm retention controls.

Also: can your team run a brief network diagram so our assessors can see boundary demarcation? If you can circulate that before the kickoff, it would speed things up.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Claire Zhang
Security Program Manager
Acme Enterprise

Jonas / Laura / Claire —

Quick tech notes on scope and artifacts (answers to Claire's questions):
- Hosted vs Dedicated: hosted API is multi-tenant; we can generate tenant-specific evidence (audit logs, config snapshots, token usage) but the boundary is logical. Dedicated pilot will require separate network segmentation evidence and a short change freeze.
- Residency: we can produce US-only evidence sets by filtering logs & backups by region; this is a straightforward export but requires a 48-hour lead time to snapshot retention policies.
- Integrations: confirmed connectors: s3-backup@acme (uses cross-account S3 role), splunk-ingest@acme (outbound TLS only). We'll include IAM role ARNs and the most recent config change history.

Attachment: network-scope-diagram.png — shows perimeter: load balancer (GCLB), private model-serving clusters (GKE), control plane (us-east-1), KMS/HSM boundary.

If assessors want a live walkthrough of the KMS key policy, I can prepare a 30-min demo during the technical deep-dive.

-Karthik
Lead Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
